verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents its own observability: built-in real-time monitoring and logging, a TUI with real-time observability into tasks and workflows, and a community-praised flow-based UI. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-run, step-by-step timeline with inputs, outputs, retries and errors, or a dashboard the team can search and filter. missing for 10: documented per-step timeline view, per-step input/output inspection, per-step retry and error history, search/filter in the dashboard, hands-on corroboration of run-level debugging.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: Hatchet provides a full platform for queuing, automatic retries, durability, real-time monitoring, alerting, and logging.
provides real-time observability into tasks, workflows, workers, and more
The flow-based UI with triggers is killer!
